title: Report
description: The Production Risk Report. Top-level deliverable rendered by the web app.

greenlight_score.description: 0-100, deterministic function of flag severities — never asked of an LLM. NULL when the analysis is incomplete (a desk returned no own dispositions): a score must never reward desk failure by counting fewer findings.

verification_degraded.description: True when one or more flags survived only because the VERIFIER could not run (fail-open). The score is withheld in that case: an unverified run must never score like a verified one.

rating_prediction.description: Ratings Board output. Evidence-based: nearest released-film content profiles from ClickHouse (Wikipedia-derived, real ratings attached) plus the measured CARA boundary — not an LLM guess.

descriptors.description: Canonical CARA-style descriptors (one per category) the conformal_set was computed from — persisted so the set is auditable and reproducible.

beats_to_cut.description: What to change to hit the target rating.

corpus_base_rates.description: Rating -> percent of the whole corpus, the base-rate denominator for the comparables panel.

distance_spread.description: max-min cosine distance across the comparables; a tight spread means the neighbourhood is not discriminating.

comps_majority.description: Distance-weighted majority rating of the comparables — the evidence's own verdict.

divergence_reason.description: Why the desk's prediction differs from comps_majority; empty when it follows the evidence.

nearest_conflict.description: Set when the closest comparable sits at near-identity distance with a different rating — the desk was required to address it.

conformal_set.description: Pooled Mondrian conformal prediction set: 90% coverage per pooled rating group ({G,PG},{PG-13},{R,NC-17}), 92% aggregate, from the measured CARA boundary. The guarantee the report leads with; the point prediction is the desk's call within (or explicitly diverging from) it.

reconciled_after_verification.description: True when the rationale and beats_to_cut were revised so they describe only the post-verification finding set.

pre_verification.description: The rationale and beats_to_cut exactly as the desk filed them, kept for the record when reconciliation changed them.

est_cost_paths.description: Present only when the adjudication marked some remedy costs moot on the target-rating path: the same roll-up computed twice, so the two totals never silently double-count mutually exclusive remedies.

excluded.description: Every flag the adjudication ruled off the target path — the structured source of the delta attribution line. sum(excluded costs) == as_written - target_rating, to the dollar.

dimension_scores.description: Per-desk 0-100 scores, same deterministic function as greenlight_score restricted to that desk's flags. Defensible where one number is not. Withheld (empty) when the analysis is incomplete.
